parameters.jsCode:
const agentOutput = $json || {};
const orchestratorInput =
  $('Prepare Social Agent Input').item.json || {};

const recommendations =
  agentOutput.result?.recommendations || [];

return [{
  json: {
    success:
      agentOutput.success === true,
    result: {
      selectedAgent:
        'social_discovery',
      selectedRoute:
        'social_discovery',
      targetWorkflow:
        'Concierge OS - Social Discovery Agent',
      executionStatus:
        agentOutput.success === true
          ? 'completed'
          : 'failed',
      agentResponse:
        agentOutput,
      recommendations
    },
    memoryUpdates:
      agentOutput.memoryUpdates || [],
    approvalRequests:
      agentOutput.approvalRequests || [],
    logs: [
      {
        timestamp:
          new Date().toISOString(),
        workflow:
          'Concierge OS - Agent Orchestrator',
        level:
          agentOutput.success === true
            ? 'info'
            : 'error',
        correlationId:
          orchestratorInput.metadata?.correlationId || '',
        message:
          agentOutput.success === true
            ? `Social Discovery Agent returned ${recommendations.length} recommendations.`
            : 'Social Discovery Agent failed.',
        details: {
          targetWorkflow:
            'Concierge OS - Social Discovery Agent',
          recommendationCount:
            recommendations.length
        }
      },
      ...(agentOutput.logs || [])
    ],
    nextAction: {
      type:
        agentOutput.success === true
          ? 'rank_recommendations'
          : 'stop',
      targetWorkflow:
        agentOutput.success === true
          ? 'Concierge OS - Recommendation Engine'
          : null
    },
    error:
      agentOutput.error || null
  }
}];
